title: `~` is OP_INVERT over script-number BYTES, not numeric two's-complement

provenance.note: Reconstructed from the divergence documented verbatim in commit 61796893: '~5 is -122 not -6'. Same root cause and same fix as 2026-07-12-shift-truncation, but a different opcode, so it needs its own entry.

rationale: 5 encodes as the 1-byte script number [0x05]; OP_INVERT flips every bit to [0xfa], which decodes as little-endian sign-magnitude to -122. Native bigint `~5` is -6. Before the fix the ANF interpreter used `~n === -(n + 1)` and rejected a spend the deployed script accepts. Both engines must now accept. Asserted on both a literal operand (guards the constant folder) and a witness operand (guards the runtime opcode).
